item.title: Falcons Hire Tommy Rees as Offensive Coordinator
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons have named Tommy Rees offensive coordinator, the team announced Thursday. It’ll be a reunion for Rees and newly-appointed Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski.
